name: Circle
overview: Scripture reveals the concept of the circle as a divine design element that demonstrates God's sovereignty and creative order. Isaiah 40:22 speaks of God sitting upon the circle of the earth, emphasizing His authority over the world and its inhabitants. Proverbs 8:27 and Job 26:10 describe God setting and bounding the heavens and waters with a compass or circle, highlighting His precise and purposeful creation. Together, these verses underscore that the circle symbolizes God's perfect control over the cosmos, while John 3:16 reminds us that this Creator's love is manifested through the gift of eternal life in Christ.
